item.title: WRR101 Focus on the Arts: Visiting with Leonidas Kavakos | Classical 101.1 FM | WRR-FM
item.description: WRR's Emilio Alvarez is joined by Leonidas Kavakos, the Dallas Symphony Orchestra's Artist-in-Residence, to discuss his three-pronged career as a world-renowned violinist, his new life as an educator, and his quickly developing role as a conductor.

item.title: WRR101 Focus on the Arts: Yes, opera has real-life superheroes | Classical 101.1 FM | WRR-FM
item.description: Dallas Opera General Director and CEO Ian Derrer's day began with a phone call that no General Director wants to receive on the day of a performance -the lead role in that evening's production of Don Carlo had fallen ill and would not be able to perform. The race was on to find a replacement, then to get him from Miami to Dallas in a matter of hours. item.title: KERA ARTS: Musical composer and conductor, David Itkin, talks with WRR | Classical 101.1 FM | WRR-FM
item.description: Musical composer and conductor, David Itkin, sits down with classical music station WRR 101.1 host, Brooke Scholl, and talk growing up with music, his latest book and much more.

item.title: Adam Gopnik salutes the immigrant experience that shaped American music
item.description: In a conversation with pianist Lara Downes, the New Yorker staff writer says music in America will keep evolving as long as the country keeps an open door to new people and new sounds.

item.title: The drama backstage: How a Miami singer came to Dallas Opera’s rescue with minutes to spare | Classical 101.1 FM | WRR-FM
item.description: When a lead singer called in sick before showtime, the race began to replace him.

item.title: WRR101 Focus on the Arts: Meet the DSO’s 2026 Music Teacher of the Year | Classical 101.1 FM | WRR-FM
item.description: Dallas Symphony Orchestra named Pamela Jenkins as the recipient of their 2026 Music Teacher of the Year, given to elementary school music teachers who demonstrate exceptional skills of connecting with students, while building their confidence through music education.

item.title: Kronos Quartet: Tiny Desk Concert
item.description: The rejuvenated band, sporting three new members, is having more fun than ever. And it shows in these vigorous performances of pieces that are whimsical and socially conscious.

item.title: WRR101 Focus on the Arts: Bruce Wood Dance’s groovy fundraiser & fiery season finale | Classical 101.1 FM | WRR-FM
item.description: North Texas audiences will travel back in time through the 1950s, 60s, and 70s with a groovy fundraiser for Bruce Wood Dance, then look forward to the company's big season finale in June 2026.

item.title: WRR101 Focus on the Arts: North Texas-based composer Taylor Scott Davis’ Requiem for our time | Classical 101.1 FM | WRR-FM
item.description: North Texas-based composer and VOCES8 Composer in Residence Taylor Scott Davis describes his new Requiem as being "a Requiem for our time. It’s about sitting with one another in grief and in hope without needing all of the answers.”

item.title: WRR101 Focus on the Arts: Speaking with Broadway legend Brian Stokes Mitchell ahead of Dallas visit | Classical 101.1 FM | WRR-FM
item.description: Broadway legend Brian Stokes Mitchell is the recipient of SMU's 2026 Meadows Award , recognizing an artist of national or international renown who has soared to the utmost height of their profession. He'll perform with the Meadows School Orchestra and Choir at the Meadows at the Meyerson benefit concert March 31, 2026, then lead a master class at SMU the following day.

item.title: Going up! 'Elevator Songs' is a high-concept, emotionally turbulent ride
item.description: On a new album, the experimental vocal group Roomful of Teeth and songwriter Gabriel Kahane take up residence in a multidimensional hotel with a time-traveling elevator and a quirky clientele.
